title: CM offers silk robes to Goddess Durga on ‘Moola Nakshatram’; over 1.3 lakh have darshan
description: Chandrababu Naidu and his wife Bhuvaneswari perform special puja at the temple atop Indrakeeladri; extending Dasara greetings, CM says he sought the Goddess’s blessings for the well-being and happiness of all people
